content_of_post_to_comment: The discourse about academia is deeply broken. Remember that social media hot takes are dominated by people with the most extreme views and most people who stay silent have more nuanced, ambivalent or complex views. Surfacing more of these perspectives would certainly balance things out.
comment: The challenge may be that nuance itself is less shareable than certainty. Perhaps academia needs better ways to make complexity visible, not just better arguments against extremes.
